knowledge.title: Portfolio Overview
knowledge.content: GrowthsStack.Dev has built more than 35 software projects, including AI applications, automation systems, backend architectures, APIs, dashboards, and SaaS platforms. The focus is on scalable, AI-powered solutions that solve real business problems.

knowledge.title: MatchAI Resume Analyzer
knowledge.content: MatchAI Resume Analyzer is an AI-powered resume analysis platform. It helps evaluate resumes, compare candidate profiles, and generate intelligent insights to support recruitment workflows. The platform demonstrates AI document processing and structured analysis.

knowledge.title: Lumina AI
knowledge.content: Lumina AI is an AI-powered application focused on intelligent workflows and modern AI capabilities. It demonstrates conversational AI, automation, backend engineering, and scalable architecture.

knowledge.title: FoundrIQ Platform
knowledge.content: FoundrIQ Platform is a scalable platform built with modern backend architecture. It showcases SaaS concepts, user management, APIs, authentication, dashboards, and scalable engineering practices.

knowledge.title: MedAnalyze AI
knowledge.content: MedAnalyze AI is an AI-based healthcare-related application that demonstrates document analysis, AI-assisted workflows, intelligent data processing, and scalable backend systems. Any deployment in regulated healthcare environments should comply with applicable privacy and regulatory requirements.

knowledge.title: AI Chatbots
knowledge.content: GrowthsStack.Dev develops custom AI chatbots for businesses, customer support, lead generation, websites, internal tools, and knowledge bases using OpenAI-compatible models and RAG.

knowledge.title: AI Agents
knowledge.content: Custom AI agents are developed for autonomous workflows, API interactions, document processing, task automation, CRM automation, and business intelligence.

knowledge.title: Backend Systems
knowledge.content: Backend systems include FastAPI applications, REST APIs, authentication systems, PostgreSQL databases, Redis caching, Docker deployment, and cloud infrastructure.

knowledge.title: Automation Systems
knowledge.content: Automation projects connect multiple business systems using APIs, webhooks, AI services, and cloud platforms to eliminate repetitive manual tasks.

knowledge.title: Dashboard Systems
knowledge.content: Dashboard projects provide analytics, reporting, KPIs, user management, AI insights, and business monitoring with responsive interfaces.

knowledge.title: API Architectures
knowledge.content: Projects include secure REST APIs, authentication, webhook integrations, cloud deployment, logging, monitoring, and third-party integrations.

knowledge.title: AI SaaS Platforms
knowledge.content: GrowthsStack.Dev builds scalable AI SaaS platforms with subscriptions, authentication, dashboards, AI features, cloud deployment, and API-first architecture.
